data.description:
## Context

DSO's host-project configuration today distributes a single conceptual choice — workflow mode — across four correlated `dso-config.conf` keys (`merge.strategy`, `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, `attribution.enabled`) plus three session-scoped environment variables (`SPRINT_MODE` derived by `mode-detect.sh`, `DSO_SPRINT_MODE` set by sprint Phase F, `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE` set by `merge-to-main-pr.sh`). The four config keys can be set into combinations that have no coherent meaning (e.g., `merge.strategy=pr` + `enforcement.strategy=local`), and consumers branch on derived signals as if they were primary, so silent half-states pick the wrong pipeline. The proximate failure surfaced as bug `e21b-1809-eb04-477c`: PR #124's sprint inferred the wrong mode, never created or pushed `story/4100-95a4/*` branches, and `sprint-story-review.yml` never fired. This epic collapses the four keys + three env vars into a single `dso.workflow=local|ci-pr` toggle, with a hybrid shim+migrator strategy that follows the project's established `ticket-migrate-*.sh` pattern.

Cleanup blast-radius (three-tier breakdown): (a) hot-path scripts (`merge-to-main.sh`, `merge-to-main-pr.sh`, `mode-detect.sh`, `check-sprint-trailer.sh`, `apply-attribution-trailers.sh`) — require TDD regression tests written RED before any change; touched by the sprint/commit pipeline. (b) Orchestrator-facing skill files (~14 `plugins/dso/skills/**/*.md`) — change-and-validate via existing skill tests. (c) Reference / documentation files (`CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`, `INSTALL.md`, `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`, `dso-config.reference.conf`, host-level `CLAUDE.md` and ADRs) — update last; grep-verified by SC6.

Semantic change acknowledged: `mode-detect.sh` today checks `merge.strategy=pr AND enforcement.strategy=ci AND git remote non-empty` to return `ci-pr`. The new design moves remote detection to `/dso:onboarding` (write-time) and trusts the committed `dso.workflow` value at read-time. A host project with `dso.workflow=ci-pr` committed but no remote (offline / local dev) now returns `ci-pr` rather than `local`. The migration trigger pattern matches the existing ticket-migrate-* invocations: the migrator runs silently from skill preambles with `|| true`, marker-gated; the resulting `dso-config.conf` diff is staged and committed by the migration commit.

## Success Criteria

1. After the migrator runs on a host project, `.claude/dso-config.conf` contains the literal line `dso.workflow=<local|ci-pr>` exactly once, and each of the four legacy keys appears only as a commented-out line annotated `# migrated to dso.workflow (v<plugin-ver>)`. The migration commit auto-stages both the rewritten config and the sentinel file. Verifiable by `git diff` on the file before and after migrator invocation against a fixture project.

2. `read-config.sh dso.workflow` returns the correct value when invoked against four fixture configs: (a) legacy keys only — returns the shim-derived value with a one-time stderr deprecation warning per process invocation naming each legacy key (CI-suppressible via `DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1`, which `validate.sh --ci` sets automatically); (b) `dso.workflow` only — returns the canonical value with no warning; (c) contradictory legacy config — emits a stderr warning naming the conflicting keys and falls back to `local`. Contradictory is defined as any combination where the four legacy keys imply conflicting pipeline modes (test fixture covers `merge.strategy=pr` + `enforcement.strategy=local` and `merge.strategy=direct` + `enforcement.strategy=ci`); (d) no `dso-config.conf` present — non-zero exit with stderr message directing to `/dso:onboarding`. Verifiable by a shell test invoking the shim against four checked-in fixture configs.

3. `migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh` is idempotent following the existing `ticket-migrate-*` pattern: running it twice on the same fixture project produces a zero-byte diff on the second run; supports `--dry-run` (read-only); self-guards by exiting 0 without modifying anything when invoked from within the plugin's own source tree (shell test covers true-positive AND false-positive: host project with a `plugins/dso/` subdirectory that is NOT the plugin source repo). The migrator writes the new config to a temp file in the same directory, fsyncs, then renames atomically; the sentinel `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` is created after the config-rename succeeds. The migrator documents the supported `dso-config.conf` grammar (unquoted `key=value`, `# comment` lines, blank lines); rejects files with inline comments after values, quoted values, duplicate keys, or CRLF line endings with a non-zero exit and clear diagnostic, without mutating the file. If a `.dso-config.conf.pre-migrate-backup` from a prior failed run exists, the migrator detects it and does not overwrite it. No `--rollback` flag — recovery is `git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf` (documented in the migrator's header comment). Verifiable by shell test that runs the migrator twice and asserts `git diff` is empty, plus separate tests for grammar rejection and self-guard cases.

4. `/dso:onboarding` writes `dso.workflow=ci-pr` to `dso-config.conf` when invoked on a project whose `git remote get-url origin` matches `https://github.com/` or `git@github.com:`, and `dso.workflow=local` otherwise; enterprise GitHub hosts default to `local` pending explicit user override. `read-config.sh` directs the user to run `/dso:onboarding` when no `dso-config.conf` is present. Verifiable by a shell test covering fixture remotes: https GitHub, ssh GitHub, no origin, GitLab — each producing the expected `dso.workflow` value.

5. After the per-project sentinel `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated` exists (committed to the host repository, not gitignored), subsequent reads via `read-config.sh` of any of the four legacy keys produce a non-zero exit code with a stderr message referencing the recovery command (`git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf`), and the shim's compat translation path is disabled. The migrator emits a reminder to `git add` the sentinel if it detects `.gitignore` covers `.claude/`. Verifiable by a shell test that touches the sentinel and asserts the error path against a fixture config containing a re-added legacy key.

6. No file in any of these categories references `merge.strategy`, `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, `attribution.enabled`, the `SPRINT_MODE` env variable, the `DSO_SPRINT_MODE` env variable, or the `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE` env variable: (a) `plugins/dso/skills/**/*.md`; (b) `plugins/dso/scripts/**/*.sh|*.py`; (c) `plugins/dso/hooks/**`; (d) `.github/workflows/*.yml`. Exempt paths: the migrator script, the compat shim in `read-config.sh`, the reference docs (`dso-config.reference.conf`, `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`, `INSTALL.md`, `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`), the host-project `CLAUDE.md` and ADRs (rewritten to teach `dso.workflow` as primary), and the entire `tests/` tree. Verifiable by `grep -rln` with `--exclude-dir=tests` and an explicit allowlist for the named exempt files.

7. After this epic, `check-sprint-trailer.sh` and `apply-attribution-trailers.sh` operate under this four-cell behavior matrix, all four cells covered by shell tests:
   - (1) `dso.workflow=ci-pr` + `.sprint-active` marker present → enforce trailer / inject trailer.
   - (2) `dso.workflow=ci-pr` + no `.sprint-active` → no-op.
   - (3) `dso.workflow=local` + `.sprint-active` → no-op (matches current local-mode behavior: trailer is not enforced during local sprints).
   - (4) `dso.workflow=local` + no `.sprint-active` → no-op.

## Approach

Add `dso.workflow=local|ci-pr` as the canonical single key. Compat shim in `read-config.sh` maps the four legacy keys → `dso.workflow` at read time, with deprecation warning suppressible via `DSO_DEPRECATION_QUIET=1`. Idempotent `migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh` (modeled on `ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh`, marker-gated via `.claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated`, `--dry-run` only — NO `--rollback`, plugin-source-repo self-guard, atomic write semantics) rewrites `dso-config.conf` in place. Re-aim ~95 distinct references across the three blast-radius tiers (hot-path scripts, skill files, docs). `/dso:onboarding` writes `dso.workflow` based on GitHub remote detection. The `DSO_SPRINT_MODE` and `MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE` env vars are eliminated; their semantics derive from `dso.workflow=ci-pr` AND the `.sprint-active` marker. `mode-detect.sh` is reduced to a one-line `read-config.sh dso.workflow` lookup; the legacy git-remote guard is intentionally dropped (remote detection moves to `/dso:onboarding` at write-time). Migrator runs silently from skill preambles, matching the existing ticket-migrate-* invocation pattern; resulting config + sentinel diff are auto-staged and committed by the migration commit.

## Dependencies

None blocking. Relates-to / coordination (consideration signals from cross-epic scan): `136b-6758`, `2a13-0c87`, `8623-8d6a` (all touch `/dso:onboarding`); `70f6-05f1` (depends on `worktree.isolation_enabled` semantics); `7ac3-71a1` (adds new `dso-config.conf` keys on an orthogonal axis); `5018-64ce` (REVIEW-DEFENSE cleanup overlap on scripts/hooks). Resolved by this epic (close-as-superseded post-merge): `e21b-1809-eb04-477c`, `cd24-6553-9d69-40fe`, `fb32-215c-4c78-4e36`. Out of scope: `70fe-1c39-121b-4e08` (planning meta-bug, separate epic); plugin version-rollback compatibility (deferred — `--dry-run` plus git history is the manual recovery path); host-project automation outside `plugins/dso/` that may reference the eliminated env vars (deferred to a release-note migration guide); end-to-end regression test for `e21b-1809-eb04-477c` (accepted gap — Value/validation_signal=3 in fidelity review; PIL marker records the compromise).
data.title: Consolidate workflow-mode config into single dso.workflow key (with hybrid shim + idempotent migrator)
